messages:
sam: Heads-up: us-west spot eviction spike, ~18% churn over last 5m. queuing up on the ingress and tail latencies creeping.
infra-bot: Alert: preemptible-node-surge detected in cluster=gpu-us-west-2 (evictions=27 in 300s). autoscaler activity suppressed by cooldown.
rob: Any immediate mitigation we can flip? region failover or traffic shed?
mia: Short-term: fanout overflow to us-east and send lower-tier traffic to quantized variants. warm pool for paid tenants only.
ana: (typo) ana: Important: if we switch to quantized model variant we invalidate KV cache memkeys. need a cache prefix shim or async rehydrate to avoid cold-start noise.
rob: +1 on shim. also reduce autoscaler.cooldown from 300s -> 60s so warm nodes pop faster.
mia: Proposed routing patch (will apply Canary to 10%):
```
routing:
  - match: {region: us-west, tier: free}
    action: fallback_to_variant
    variant: ggml-quant1
    weight: 100
  - match: {region: us-west, tier: paid}
    action: failover_region
    region: us-east
    weight: 50
  - match: {region: us-west, tier: paid}
    action: warm_pool_steal
    pool: dedicated-warm
    weight: 50
```
sam: Also temp tweak: evict-escape-hint on request level so the router requeues to warm pool rather than dropping.
infra-bot: Running check: `kubectl get nodes -l preemptible=true -o wide` returned 84 nodes, 18 NotReady, 9 Terminating.
ops-oncall: I'm going to trigger canary now for 10% of free tier. monitoring: latency P95 and error-rate.
ana: For cache we can add prefix mapping: `cache-v2:us-west:base-key -> cache-v2:us-east:quant:base-key` and kick async rehydrator. I'll open a short-lived job.
rob: Make sure to include model-quality guard: quant fallback only allowed for text-gen routes, not codegen or long-contexts, else quality alarms.
mia: Good call. I'll add rule to the canary config.
ops-oncall: Canary started at 1945674335. Watching.
infra-bot: Metric update (30s): ingress queue down 40%, p95 latency improved from 1.2s -> 0.55s for canaryed traffic.
sam: Nice. ops, once we see stability for 5m we can scale canary to 50% and start spin-up of extra warm nodes in us-east.
ops-oncall: Scaling canary to 50% now. also bumped autoscaler.cooldown to 60s and increased warm pool target by +12 GPUs.
ana: Deploying cache-prefix shim and launch rehydrator job.
infra-bot: Rehydrator job started. warm-cache hits rising.
rob: Postmortem action items: (1) automated warmpool pre-warm on predicted spot drain windows, (2) KV prefix compatibility layer for variant fallbacks, (3) route rule library for tiered degrade modes.
sam: Agreed. I'll own #1 with infra-scheduling. Mia own #3, Ana own #2.
ops-oncall: Will keep monitoring for the hour, ping if anything flares. :eyes:
sam: Thanks team. update in 30m with stability metrics. :thumbsup:
